_meta.title: VTU CSE viva question bank
_meta.note: Subject codes verified against the VTU 2022 scheme. Module numbers follow the standard VTU module split for each course; check your own scheme PDF if your college reorders modules. Questions are ordinary viva questions, written for this project.

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: What are the four necessary conditions for a deadlock?
questions.followUp: How would a resource-allocation graph show you one?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: What is a semaphore, and how does a binary semaphore differ from a mutex?
questions.followUp: Where can a busy-waiting semaphore go wrong?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: Walk me through the five states of a process.
questions.followUp: Which transition never happens, and why?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: What is the difference between preemptive and non-preemptive scheduling?
questions.followUp: Which one does a hard real-time system prefer?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: What is thrashing, and what causes it?
questions.followUp: What does the working-set model do about it?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: Explain page replacement with LRU. Why can Belady's anomaly not happen with LRU?
questions.followUp: What does LRU cost you that FIFO does not?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: What is a system call? Give two examples and say why each needs one.
questions.followUp: What is the difference between a system call and a library call?

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: What is an inode, and what does it deliberately not contain?
questions.followUp: How does a hard link differ from a symbolic link?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: Convert A + B * C into postfix and explain each step.
questions.followUp: Where does the stack come into it?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: Why does a circular queue exist? What breaks in a linear array queue?
questions.followUp: How do you tell a full circular queue from an empty one?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: How do you detect a cycle in a singly linked list without using extra memory?
questions.followUp: What is the time complexity, and why?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: What is the difference between a binary search tree and a heap?
questions.followUp: Which one would you use for a priority queue, and why?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: Name the three depth-first traversals. Which one gives sorted output for a BST?
questions.followUp: Which traversal would you use to free the tree?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: BFS and DFS: when would you reach for each?
questions.followUp: What data structure does each one need?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: Why is quicksort O(n log n) on average but O(n squared) in the worst case?
questions.followUp: How do you avoid the worst case in practice?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: Explain collision resolution by chaining. What is the worst-case lookup?
questions.followUp: When would open addressing be the better choice?

questions.subject: Data Structures
questions.question: How would you store a sparse matrix, and what do you gain?
questions.followUp: What operation becomes slower with your representation?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Define Big-O, Big-Theta and Big-Omega with one example each.
questions.followUp: Which one actually describes an algorithm's running time?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Is 2 to the power n plus 1 equal to O(2 to the power n)? Explain.
questions.followUp: Does the constant in the exponent matter for Big-O?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: State the master theorem and apply it to T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n.
questions.followUp: Which case are you in, and how do you know?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Why is merge sort a better fit than quicksort for a linked list?
questions.followUp: What extra space does your merge sort need?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Why does Kruskal's algorithm need a union-find structure?
questions.followUp: What goes wrong if you only check whether two vertices are adjacent?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Give a problem where a greedy choice fails but dynamic programming works.
questions.followUp: Which property is missing in that problem?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: What two properties must a problem have before dynamic programming applies?
questions.followUp: How does memoisation differ from tabulation?

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Explain N-queens with backtracking. What is the bounding function doing?
questions.followUp: What is the worst-case size of the state space tree?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: What is the difference between a weak entity and a strong entity?
questions.followUp: How does a weak entity get its primary key?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: Explain the difference between a super key, a candidate key and a primary key.
questions.followUp: Can a relation have two primary keys? Why not?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: What does a LEFT JOIN return that an INNER JOIN does not?
questions.followUp: When would the extra rows have NULLs in them?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: What problem does 3NF remove that 2NF does not?
questions.followUp: Give me a small table that violates it.

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: When would you deliberately denormalise a schema?
questions.followUp: What do you have to maintain by hand once you do?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: State the ACID properties. Which one does a bank transfer lean on most?
questions.followUp: What happens if the system crashes between the debit and the credit?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: What is a dirty read, and which isolation level prevents it?
questions.followUp: What is the cost of that isolation level?

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: Why does a B+ tree beat a binary search tree for a database index?
questions.followUp: Why are the values kept in the leaves?

questions.followUp: Which layer would you change to add encryption?

questions.followUp: Which one does the internet actually run on?

questions.followUp: What replaced it in full-duplex links?

questions.subject: Computer Networks
questions.question: How does a sliding window improve throughput over stop-and-wait?
questions.followUp: What limits how large the window can be?

questions.subject: Computer Networks
questions.question: What is the difference between a router and a switch?
questions.followUp: Which layer does each one make its decision at?

questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.followUp: How does a peer-to-peer app get around it?

questions.question: Walk me through the TCP three-way handshake.

questions.subject: Computer Networks
questions.question: What happens, step by step, when you type a URL into a browser?
